ValidationRule.description: Retention days, token, message, idle timeout and tool-calling limits must each be 1 or more, or left blank.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(ConversationRetentionDays__c)), ConversationRetentionDays__c < 1), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(MaxTokensPerConversation__c)), MaxTokensPerConversation__c < 1), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(MaxMessagesPerConversation__c)), MaxMessagesPerConversation__c < 1), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(IdleTimeoutMinutes__c)), IdleTimeoutMinutes__c < 1), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(MaxToolCallingIterations__c)), MaxToolCallingIterations__c < 1))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Retention days, token, message, idle timeout and tool-calling limits must each be 1 or more, or left blank.
